#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

ll unit[17];

int dfs(ll n, int d)
{
    ll q = n / unit[d];
    int base = (int)(q * d);
    ll r = n - q * unit[d];

    if (r == 0) return base;

    int takeComplement = dfs(unit[d] - r, d - 1) + d;
    int takeRemainder = dfs(r, d - 1);
    int best = takeComplement < takeRemainder ? takeComplement : takeRemainder;
    return base + best;
}

int main()
{
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        unit[i] = unit[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    printf("%d\n", dfs(n, 16));
    return 0;
}

        ll r = x % rep[d];

        if (r == 0) return res;

        return res + (left < right ? left : right);

    return 0;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

struct Frame
{
    ll x;
    int d;
    int phase;
    int base;
    ll rem;
    int leftResult;
};

int main()
{
    ll rep[17] = {};
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        rep[i] = rep[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<Frame> st;
    st.reserve(64);
    st.push_back({n, 16, 0, 0, 0, 0});
    int returned = 0;

    while (!st.empty())
    {
        Frame &f = st.back();

        if (f.phase == 0)
        {
            ll q = f.x / rep[f.d];
            f.base = (int)(q * f.d);
            f.rem = f.x - q * rep[f.d];

            if (f.rem == 0)
            {
                returned = f.base;
                st.pop_back();
            }
            else
            {
                f.phase = 1;
                st.push_back({rep[f.d] - f.rem, f.d - 1, 0, 0, 0, 0});
            }
        }
        else if (f.phase == 1)
        {
            f.leftResult = returned + f.d;
            f.phase = 2;
            st.push_back({f.rem, f.d - 1, 0, 0, 0, 0});
        }
        else
        {
            returned = f.base + (f.leftResult < returned ? f.leftResult : returned);
            st.pop_back();
        }
    }

    printf("%d\n", returned);
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

ll rep[17];
map<pair<ll, int>, int> memo;

int dfs(ll n, int d)
{
    auto key = make_pair(n, d);
    auto it = memo.find(key);
    if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;

    int res = (int)((n / rep[d]) * d);
    ll r = n % rep[d];

    int ans;
    if (r == 0)
        ans = res;
    else
        ans = res + min(dfs(rep[d] - r, d - 1) + d, dfs(r, d - 1));

    memo[key] = ans;
    return ans;
}

int main()
{
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        rep[i] = rep[i - 1] * 10 + 1;

    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    printf("%d\n", dfs(n, 16));
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

struct Solver
{
    ll rep[17];

    Solver()
    {
        rep[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
            rep[i] = rep[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }

    int operator()(ll n, int d) const
    {
        ll q = n / rep[d];
        int base = (int)(q * d);
        ll r = n % rep[d];

        if (r == 0) return base;

        int takeComplement = (*this)(rep[d] - r, d - 1) + d;
        int takeRemainder = (*this)(r, d - 1);
        return base + min(takeComplement, takeRemainder);
    }
};

int main()
{
    Solver solver;
    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solver(n, 16) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
